crops.text: (OFS) This creature cannot be targeted by the enemy until the end of its first turn.This creature gains 2 combo counters for each successful attack (max 6).(1CD) Can spend all combo counters to do one of the following:Deal 2(x counters) DMG to a creature on the PF.Inflict 1T1(x counters) Enfeebled.Inflict 2T1(x counters) Softened.
